column1: # Per-wallpaper limits for the macOS (Metal, Apple GPU) vs Linux (Vulkan, lavapipe) comparison of the test set
# (scripts/linux/pixeldiff.py --thresholds; docs/linux-port.md §7). 1280×720 at t = 2 s, PHOTON_SEED=1, macOS reference
# rendered right before the Linux frame, lavapipe with GALLIVM_PERF=no_aos_sampling (the image's default, §7).
# Columns: id, max mean absolute per-channel difference (0..255), max pixels whose largest channel difference is > 32.
# Set from the phase-4 table (2026-10-14 `ci.sh --mac --native-gs --x11 --audio`): mean × 1.25 + 0.05 and pixels × 1.5 + 20,
# so lavapipe/Mesa or font updates fit and a real regression (a pass missing, a wrong blend, shifted geometry) does not.
# The two text-heavy scenes show seconds, frames per second and a random kaomoji, so their limits also add what two macOS
# renders of the same scene differ by (3351163962: mean 0.049, 1,210 px; 2902406982: mean 0.128, 709 px).
